items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was talking to Tom Scott on an interview. [INTERVIEWEE] The sax player?

ctx.x: and Ed Ward, the president of Chicago we were big unions, they didn’t like that because they didn’t think we were thinking of them and yet we were telling them the music performance payment that you get to play your summer gigs from the Music Performance Trust Fund, that comes from musicians that record in New York, L.A., Chicago and Nashville. A certain amount of that money goes to create the Performance Fund. So you guys got that money by doing your concerts in the summertime. And so you know we aren’t here to…
I was talking to Tom Scott on an interview.
